data.one_liner: Pure Dart metadata reader and writer for MP3, MP4, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WAV, AIFF, and APE files.
data.what_it_does: Reads and writes audio metadata such as titles, artists, albums, track numbers, and cover art across various audio formats using a pure Dart implementation.
use_when: You need to read or update ID3, Vorbis comments, or iTunes ILST tags in audio files
You are building a local music player and need fast batch parsing of tracks
You want a pure Dart solution without platform-specific audio library requirements for metadata
avoid_when: You need to actually play or record audio files
You are working with audio formats that are not supported by the library
strengths: Pure Dart implementation supporting multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Extremely fast performance for batch processing large music directories
Supports both reading and writing metadata for several formats
weaknesses: Some formats (like OGG, Opus, AIFF) are read-only for metadata
Fetching large embedded images can impact reading performance
